name: io.github.ciperx/verify-mcp
description: SHA-256 artifact verification and Base USDC transfer verification for AI agents. Three tools: verify_artifact, verify_base_tx (0.10 USDC per call via x402 on Base) and health (free).

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAYMENT_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Base64 X-PAYMENT payload for the x402 challenge (0.10 USDC on Base). Optional: without it, paid tools return the 402 challenge instead of a verdict.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Default https://agent.ggez.my.id

tools.name: verify_artifact
tools.description: Verify a SHA-256 digest server-side; returns PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL. Paid 0.10 USDC via x402.

tools.name: verify_base_tx
tools.description: Decode a Base USDC Transfer log and check recipient/amount. Paid 0.10 USDC via x402.
